item.title: Lee Jun-seok: “If Hundreds of Ballots Were Missing, Any Outcome is Problematic… Vote Counting Must Be Suspended” (이준석 “수백표씩 용지 부족했다면 어떤 결과 나와도 문제… 개표 중지해야”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, argued on the 3rd that “vote counting procedures should be suspended” in response to the incident where voting was halted in some areas of Seoul due to a shortage of local election ballots. (개혁신당 이준석 대표는 3일 서울 일부 지역에서 지방선거 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단된 사태가 벌어진 데 대해 “개표 절차를 중지해야 한다”고 주장했다.)

In a Facebook post that evening, Lee stated, “The shortage of ballots in this Seoul mayoral election and other various-level elections is not a matter to be taken lightly.” (이 대표는 이날 밤 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이번에 서울시장 선거 및 각급 선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 문제는 가볍게 다룰 문제가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Regarding the fact that the Songpa District Election Commission and others had prepared only about 50% of the ballots needed for the number of voters, Lee said, “Whether the decision to print fewer ballots was based on guidelines or was a judgment made by local election commissions themselves must be thoroughly addressed later in the National Assembly.” (이 대표는 송파구선관위 등이 투표용지를 유권자 수의 50% 정도만 준비한 것에 대해 “투표용지를 적게 인쇄한 것이 지침에 따른 것인지, 지역별 선관위의 자체적 판단인지는 국회에서 나중에 엄중하게 다뤄야 한다”고 했다.)

He then added, “Before that, the vote counting process must be halted.” Explaining his reasoning, Lee pointed out, “Given that these are local elections where multiple races are held simultaneously, elections other than the Seoul mayoral race—such as those for district heads, city councilors, and district councilors—will be impacted by the missing votes in determining the outcome.” (그러면서 “그 전에 개표 절차를 중지해야 한다”고 했다. 그 이유에 대해 이 대표는 “여러 선거가 동시에 치러지는 지방선거인 만큼, 서울시장이 아닌 (구청장·시의원·구의원 등) 다른 선거는 부족한 표가 당락에 영향을 미칠 것”이라고 지적했다.)

Lee also noted, “The fact that voting continued for a significant period after exit polls were reported creates potential for distorted results.” He argued, “While we have conventionally accepted minor discrepancies, such as people who entered polling stations before 6 p.m. voting after that time, it’s problematic if voters who had already seen exit polls continued voting for hours, as happened this time.” (이 대표는 “출구조사가 보도된 뒤에 한참 동안 그 투표들이 진행된 것 자체가 투표가 왜곡될 소지가 있다”고도 했다. 이 대표는 “그간 편의상 (6시에 출구조사 결과를 발표하면서도) 투표소에 입장한 사람들이 6시가 넘어서 투표하는 정도의 오차를 인정했지만, 이번처럼 출구조사를 이미 본 사람들이 몇 시간씩 투표했다면 문제가 있다”고 했다.)

In this regard, Lee stated, “The election commission might think, ‘If we assume the maximum number of voters at the affected polling stations voted, and the vote margin falls within that range, there’s no issue,’ but this situation is different. If ballot shortages occurred by the hundreds or thousands, any vote count outcome, regardless of what it is, will carry significant political implications.” (이와 관련해 이 대표는 “아마 선관위는 ‘문제가 된 투표소의 최대 인원이 투표했다고 가정하고, 그 범위 내에 표차가 있으면 문제가 안 된다고 하면 된다’고 생각하겠지만, 이 상황은 그런 상황이 아니다”라며 “수백, 수천 표 단위로 용지 부족이 발생했다면 그 자체로 어떤 개표 결과가 나오더라도 정치적 의미가 크다”고 했다.)

He further remarked, “Once the vote counting is completed, numbers are set, and subsequent judgments on how to handle it become retrospective, which in itself is problematic.” (“개표가 끝나버리면, 일단 숫자가 나오고 어떻게 처분할지에 대한 사후적 판단이 되기 때문에, 그 자체로 문제가 된다”고도 했다.)

Lee emphasized, “Vote counting should be suspended first, and the central election commission members should convene an emergency meeting to make an official judgment and provide direction on this situation. Local election commissions should not make their own decisions and proceed with counting.” (이 대표는 “개표를 우선 중지하고, 중앙선관위원들이 긴급 회의를 소집해서 이 상황에 대한 공식적인 판단 및 지휘를 해야 한다”며 “지역선관위 등이 이런 것에 대해 판단해서 (개표를) 진행하면 안 된다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: PPP: "Seoul Election Contaminated... Halt Vote Counting, Hold Re-Election" (국힘 “서울시 선거 오염... 개표 중단, 재선거 하라”)
item.description:
PPP: "Seoul Election Contaminated... Halt Vote Counting, Hold Re-Election" (국힘 “서울시 선거 오염... 개표 중단, 재선거 하라”)

People Power Party (PPP) Representative Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 3rd regarding the shortage of local election ballots in some areas of Seoul, "The election in Seoul is already contaminated. A contaminated election is invalid." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 3일 서울 일부 지역에서 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 것과 관련해 “이미 서울시의 선거는 오염된 선거다. 오염된 선거는 무효”라고 했다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk held an emergency press conference at the PPP headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, that afternoon, saying, "Even now, vote counting should be halted immediately until the facts are determined," and "Based on the findings, the Seoul election should be held again." (장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 서울 여의도 당사에서 긴급 기자회견을 열고 “지금이라도 진상 파악이 이뤄질 때까지 즉시 개표를 중단해야 된다”면서 “진상 파악 결과에 따라 서울시의 선거를 다시 실시해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Representative Jang said, "There are voters who gave up voting while waiting for ballots, and voters who abandoned going to the polling stations altogether after hearing news of the 'ballot shortage,'" adding, "For voters who voted after the 6 p.m. deadline, because they voted after seeing exit poll broadcasts, the possibility of influence on the voting cannot be ruled out." He continued, "This election in Seoul is one where voters' right to vote and political rights have been severely violated." (장 대표는 “투표용지를 기다리다가 투표를 포기한 유권자가 있고, ‘투표용지 부족 사태’ 뉴스를 접하고 아예 투표장에 갈 것을 포기한 유권자도 있다”며 “(투표 종료 시한인) 6시 이후에 투표를 진행한 유권자 경우에는 개표 방송을 보고 투표했기 때문에 투표에 영향을 미쳤을 가능성도 배제할 수 없다”고 했다. 이어 그는 “이번 서울시 투표는 유권자의 투표권과 참정권이 심각하게 침해된 선거”라고 했다.)

Representative Jang stated, "Regarding this incident, the National Election Commission (NEC) must issue a clear explanation of the facts that the public can accept, state its position, and take legal responsibility accordingly." He then said he would move to the Central NEC building in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi, to demand a halt to vote counting. (장 대표는 “이번 사태에 대해 선관위가 국민들이 납득할 수 있는 명확한 사실관계 해명과 입장을 발표하고 그에 따른 법적 책임 져야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 그는 경기 과천 중앙선관위 청사로 이동해 개표 중단을 요구하기로 했다.)

Earlier that afternoon, PPP Floor Leader Song Eon-seok also held a press conference at the party headquarters and said, "We clearly demand of the NEC. We ask that vote counting for the Seoul election be halted immediately," and "We formally demand a postponement of the election under Article 196 of the Public Official Election Act." Article 196 of the election law stipulates that if local elections cannot be held or are not held due to natural disasters, unforeseen events, or other inevitable reasons, the head of the relevant constituency election commission must consult with the local government head to postpone the election. (그에 앞서 국민의힘 송언석 원내대표도 이날 오후 당사에서 기자회견을 열고 “중앙선거관리위원회에 분명히 요구한다. 서울 선거 개표를 지금 즉시 중단하기 바란다”며 “공직선거법 196조에 의거해 선거를 연기할 것을 정식으로 요구한다”고 말했다. 선거법 196조에는 지방선거에서 천재·지변, 기타 부득이한 사유로 선거를 실시할 수 없거나 실시하지 못한 때엔 관할 선거구 선관위원장이 지자체장과 협의해 선거를 연기해야 한다고 돼 있다.)

Floor Leader Song said, "Today in Seoul, an unprecedented incident occurred where voting could not take place due to a shortage of ballots," and "The scale of damage is quite large, and currently, it is difficult to even determine the extent of the damage." (송 원내대표는 “오늘 서울에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표를 하지 못하는 전대 미문의 사태가 발생했다”며 “피해 규모가 상당히 크고 지금으로서는 어느 정도 피해 규모인지 파악도 어려운 상황”이라고 했다.)

He added, "This is a serious violation of the right to vote and political rights," and "There are also very serious doubts about whether normal ballot management is being ensured during the emergency transport of ballots from other locations." He noted, "With voting continuing after 6 p.m., it is difficult to rule out the possibility that exit poll results may have influenced the voting." (그러면서 송 원내대표는 “이는 중대한 투표권 침해이자 참정권 침해”라며 “투표용지를 다른 곳에서 급하게 이송하는 과정에서 정상적인 투표지 관리가 되는지 여부에 대해 의구심도 매우 크다”고 했다. 그는 “오후 6시 이후에 투표를 진행하게 되면서 출구조사 결과가 투표에 영향을 미칠 개연성도 배제하기 어려운 상황”이라고 했다.)

Floor Leader Song stated, "The NEC issued an apology message, but this is by no means an issue that can be resolved simply with an apology from the NEC," and "This is not just a matter of inconvenience or worry for a few people. It is a serious matter that significantly undermines the fairness of the election." He continued, "Many citizens point out that this election can no longer proceed normally," and "We clearly note that it is very difficult for the Seoul election to proceed as it is." (송 원내대표는 “중앙선관위에서 사과 메시지를 냈는데 이는 단순히 선관위에서 사과한다고 끝낼 수 있는 사안이 전혀 아니다”며 “단순히 몇몇 사람의 불편과 심려의 문제가 아니다. 선거의 공정성을 중대하게 훼손하는 심각한 사안”이라고 말했다. 이어 송 원내대표는 “더 이상 이 선거가 정상적으로 진행되기 어렵다는 것이 많은 국민들의 지적”이라며 “서울 선거는 이대로 진행하기가 매우 어렵다는 점을 분명히 지적한다”고 했다.)

Earlier that afternoon, ballot shortages caused voting interruptions at polling stations in parts of Seoul, including Songpa, Gangnam, and Gwangjin. According to the PPP's Seoul City Party, at least 10 polling stations had ballot shortages as of 6 p.m. that day. These primarily included polling stations within Songpa District, such as Munjeong 1-dong Polling Station 4, Munjeong 2-dong Polling Station 2, Jamsil 2-dong Polling Station 6, Jamsil 7-dong Polling Station 2, and Jamsil 4-dong Polling Station 5. (앞서 이날 오후부턴 서울 송파, 강남, 광진 등 일부 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 사태가 발생했다. 국민의힘 서울시당에 따르면 이날 오후 6시 기준 최소 10곳이 넘는 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족했다고 한다. 문정1동 4투표소, 문정2동 2투표소, 잠실2동 6투표소, 잠실7동 2투표소, 잠실4동 5투표소 등 주로 송파구 내 투표소였다.)

According to the results of exit polls from the three major broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS), in the Seoul mayoral election, Democratic Party of Korea candidate Jung Won-oh was ahead with 51.4%, compared to PPP candidate Oh Se-hoon at 46.0%. (이번 방송(KBS·MBC·SBS) 3사 출구조사 결과 서울시장 선거는 더불어민주당 정원오 후보가 51.4%로 국민의힘 오세훈 후보(46.0%)보다 5.4%포인트 앞서는 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: Gyeonggi: Choo Mi-ae, Daejeon: Heo Tae-jeong, Chungbuk: Shin Yong-han, Ulsan: Kim Sang-wook Leading in Election (경기 추미애·대전 허태정·충북 신용한·울산 김상욱 당선 유력)
item.description:
In the vote counting results for the June 3 nationwide local elections for metropolitan and provincial governors, as of 11 p.m. on the 3rd, Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, is likely to be elected. (6·3전국동시지방선거 시·도지사 개표 결과, 3일 오후 11시 현재 추미애 더불어민주당 경기지사 후보의 당선이 유력하다.)

Additionally, Democratic Party candidates Heo Tae-jeong for Daejeon mayor, Shin Yong-han for Chungcheongbuk-do governor, and Kim Sang-wook for Ulsan mayor are also expected to win. Democratic Party candidates Min Hyeong-bae for the integrated special city of Jeonnam-Gwangju and Wi Seong-gon for Jeju governor, as well as People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo for Gyeongsangbuk-do governor, are virtually certain to be elected. (또 민주당 소속 허태정 대전시장 후보, 신용한 충북지사 후보, 김상욱 울산시장 후보 등도 당선이 유력하다. 민주당 소속 민형배 전남광주통합특별시장 후보, 위성곤 제주지사 후보와 국민의힘 소속 이철우 경북지사 후보는 당선이 확실시된다.)

According to the National Election Commission, as of 11:02 p.m., based on a 24.94% vote count, candidate Choo secured 53.15% of the votes, leading Yang Hyang-ja (41.24%) of the People Power Party, making her election likely. If Choo’s victory is confirmed, she will become the first female head of a metropolitan government in history. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면, 추 후보는 오후 11시 2분 개표율 24.94% 기준 53.15%를 득표해 양향자(41.24%) 국민의힘 후보를 앞서며 당선이 유력한 상황이다. 추 후보가 당선을 확정지으면 사상 첫 여성 광역단체장으로 기록되게 된다.)

At the same time in Daejeon, based on a 30.24% vote count, Heo Tae-jeong candidate garnered 62.09% of the votes, significantly ahead of Lee Jang-woo (35.69%) of the People Power Party. In Chungcheongbuk-do, based on a 48.32% vote count, Shin Yong-han achieved 54.80%, defeating Kim Young-hwan (45.19%) of the People Power Party. In Ulsan, with a 31.03% vote count, Kim Sang-wook leads with 55.44%, outpacing Kim Du-gyeom (39.53%) of the People Power Party. (같은 시각 대전에선 개표율 30.24% 기준으로 허태정 후보가 62.09%를 득표해 이장우(35.69%) 국민의힘 후보를 크게 앞서고 있다. 또 충북에선 신용한 후보가 개표율 48.32% 기준 54.80%를 득표해 김영환(45.19%) 국민의힘 후보를 이기고 있다. 개표율 31.03%의 울산에선 김상욱 후보가 55.44%로 김두겸(39.53%) 국민의힘 후보를 누르고 있다.)

In the integrated special city of Jeonnam-Gwangju, where Democratic Party support is strong, Min Hyeong-bae leads with 81.53%, far ahead of Lee Jeong-hyeon (9.3%). In Gyeongsangbuk-do, where People Power Party support is strong, Lee Cheol-woo leads with 64.28%, ahead of Oh Joong-gi (35.71%) of the Democratic Party. In Jeju, Wi Seong-gon leads with 62.65%, ahead of Moon Seong-yu (34%) of the People Power Party. (민주당 지지세가 강한 전남광주통합특별시에선 민형배 후보가 81.53%으로 이정현(9.3%) 후보를 크게 앞서고 있고, 국민의힘 지지세가 강한 경북에선 이철우 후보가 64.28%로 오중기(35.71%) 민주당 후보를 앞섰다. 제주에선 위성곤 후보가 62.65%로 문성유(34%) 국민의힘 후보를 앞섰다.)

item.title: 'Ballot Paper Shortage' at Jamsil 7-dong Voting Station No. 2 Extends Voting Until 10 PM (‘용지 부족’ 잠실7동 2투표소, 오후 10시까지 투표 연장)
item.description:
'Ballot Paper Shortage' at Jamsil 7-dong Voting Station No. 2 Extends Voting Until 10 PM (‘용지 부족’ 잠실7동 2투표소, 오후 10시까지 투표 연장)

On the 3rd, the day of the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, ballot paper shortages occurred at various polling stations in Seoul, and at Jamsil 7-dong Voting Station No. 2, voting was extended until 10 PM that night. (제9회 전국동시지방선거가 치러진 3일 서울 투표소 곳곳에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 가운데, 잠실7동 제2투표소에선 이날 밤 10시까지 투표가 연장됐다.)

The Seoul Election Commission decided to extend the voting deadline at Jamsil 7-dong Voting Station No. 2, allowing only those voters who had received queue tickets by the official closing time of 6 PM to cast their ballots until 10 PM. Due to the ballot paper shortage, voters waiting in line were unable to complete their voting, leading to a flood of complaints, prompting the commission to exceptionally postpone the closing time. (서울선거관리위원회는 이날 잠실7동 제2투표소에서 투표 마감 시각인 오후 6시까지 대기표를 받은 유권자들에 한해 오후 10시까지 투표를 할 수 있도록 마감 시각을 연장하기로 했다. 투표 용지 부족으로 대기 중이던 유권자들이 투표를 마치지 못해 항의가 빗발치면서, 선관위가 이례적으로 투표 마감 시각을 미루기로 한 것이다.)

At Jamsil 7-dong Voting Station No. 2, it was reported that election commission staff attempted to retrieve the ballot boxes even though some voters had not yet finished voting, resulting in a clash. Song Eon-seok, the floor leader of the People Power Party, stated, "At Jamsil 7-dong Voting Station No. 2, despite citizens still waiting to vote, they tried to retrieve the ballot boxes, and it is said that citizens and police are now in a standoff. This appears to be a clear illegal attempt to retrieve the ballot boxes." (잠실7동 제2투표소에선 일부 유권자들이 투표를 마치지 못 했는데도 선관위 직원들이 투표함을 회수하려해 충돌이 인 것으로 알려졌다. 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 “잠실7동 제2투표소에서 아직 투표를 대기 중인 시민들이 있음에도 불구하고 투표함을 회수하려 해서 지금 시민들과 경찰이 대치 상황에 있다고 한다”며 “명백하게 불법적인 투표함 회수 시도라고 보인다”고 했다.)

That day, at some polling stations in Seoul's Songpa, Gangnam, and Gwangjin districts, voting was interrupted due to a shortage of ballot papers. Some voters who visited the polling stations had to wait a long time or even turned back, and in certain areas, clashes occurred involving voters, police, and election commission staff. (이날 서울 송파와 강남, 광진구 일부 투표소에서는 투표 용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 사태가 발생했다. 투표소를 찾은 유권자들이 한참을 기다리거나 발길을 돌리는 일까지 있었고, 일부 지역에선 유권자들과 경찰, 선관위 직원들이 충돌하는 상황이 벌어졌다.)

As the controversy escalated, Heo Cheol-hoon, Secretary-General of the Election Commission, held an emergency briefing and said, "The shortage of ballot papers at polling stations caused great confusion and concern for the public. We deeply apologize and fully recognize our responsibility for undermining public trust in fair election management." However, the People Power Party stated, "We formally demand the postponement of the election under Article 196 of the Public Official Election Act," and called for an immediate halt to the vote counting for the Seoul mayoral election. <<>> (논란이 커지자 허철훈 선관위 사무총장은 긴급 브리핑을 열어 “투표소의 투표용지 부족으로 국민 여러분께 큰 혼란과 심려를 끼쳐 드렸다”며 “공정한 선거 관리에 대한 국민의 신뢰를 훼손한 점에 대해 책임을 통감하며 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다. 그러나 국민의힘은 “공직선거법 제196조에 의거해 선거를 연기할 것을 정식으로 요구한다”며 서울시장 선거 개표를 즉시 중단하자고 했다.)

item.title: Voting Suspended Across Multiple Polling Stations in Seoul's Songpa, Gangnam, and Gwangjin Districts Due to Ballot Paper Shortage (서울 송파·강남·광진구 곳곳서 투표용지 없어 중단 초유의 사태)
item.description:
Voting Suspended Across Multiple Polling Stations in Seoul's Songpa, Gangnam, and Gwangjin Districts Due to Ballot Paper Shortage (서울 송파·강남·광진구 곳곳서 투표용지 없어 중단 초유의 사태)

On the 3rd, the day of the 9th National Local Elections, voting was suspended at numerous polling stations in Songpa-gu, Seoul, due to a shortage of ballot papers. (제9회 전국지방동시선거일인 3일, 서울 송파구 다수의 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 사태가 발생했다.)

According to the National Election Commission, at least five polling stations in Songpa-gu, including those in Jamsil 4-dong and Garak 2-dong, experienced voting suspensions due to a lack of ballot papers. Some polling stations halted voting around 4:10 PM, but as of 5:20 PM, voting had not resumed. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면, 이날 송파구 잠실4동·가락2동 등의 투표소 최소 5곳에서 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 사태가 발생했다. 일부 투표소는 오후 4시 10분쯤 투표가 중단됐으나 오후 5시 20분 현재까지 투표가 재개되지 못하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

An election commission official stated, "Due to a higher-than-expected voter turnout, some polling stations ran out of ballot papers, and we are currently delivering additional supplies from the district election commission," adding, "We will ensure that voters who arrive at polling stations before 6 PM can vote normally, even if it exceeds the closing time." (선관위 관계자는 “예상보다 높은 투표율 탓에 일부 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해져 현재 지역선관위에서 투표용지를 배송하고 있다”면서 “오후 6시 전에 투표소에 도착한 인원들은 투표 마감 시각이 지나더라도 정상적으로 투표할 수 있도록 조치하겠다”고 했다.)

Numerous posts appeared on online communities reporting that voting had been suspended at polling stations in the Songpa-gu area due to ballot paper shortages, causing voters to leave. The People Power Party said, "We have confirmed that ballot paper shortages also occurred at the 4th polling station in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam-gu, and the 6th polling station in Guui 3-dong, Gwangjin-gu." A post on an online community also reported that voting was suspended at the 4th polling station in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam. However, an election commission official noted, "As of 5:45 PM, we only have reports of voting suspensions from Songpa-gu." (인터넷 커뮤니티에는 송파구 일대 투표소에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단돼 유권자들이 돌아가고 있다는 글이 다수 올라왔다. 국민의힘은 “강남구 청담동 제4투표소, 광진구 구의3동 제6투표소에서도 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 것으로 파악했다”고 했다. 실제 강남 청담동 제4투표소에서 투표가 중단됐다는 글도 인터넷 커뮤니티에 올라왔다. 다만 선관위 관계자는 “5시 45분 기준 송파구에서만 투표 중단 사실이 보고된 것으로 파악하고 있다”고 했다.)

A tipster who was unable to vote at the 6th polling station in Jamsil 2-dong, Songpa-gu, due to the ballot paper shortage told this newspaper, "Voting has been suspended since 4 PM, and many people who were waiting in line have left," adding, "Additional ballots arrived around 5:40 PM, but only 50 sheets. Over 100 people are currently waiting." (송파구 잠실2동 제6투표소에서 투표용지 부족 사태로 투표하지 못한 제보자는 본지에 “오후 4시부터 투표가 중단됐고, 줄 서다가 되돌아간 사람이 많다”면서 “오후 5시 40분쯤 추가 용지가 도착했는데 50장밖에 안 왔다. 현재 100명 넘게 대기 중”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party immediately protested the voting suspension. Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon's campaign stated, "We strongly warn the election commission. Infringing on voters' right to participate in elections like this is never acceptable. Use all available means to ensure that citizens can vote immediately. There must not be a single citizen who cannot vote due to a ballot paper shortage." (국민의힘은 투표 중단 사태에 즉각 반발했다. 오세훈 서울시장 후보 캠프는 “선관위에 강력 경고한다. 이런 식으로 유권자의 참정권을 침해하는 것은 결코 용납할 수 없다”면서 “모든 수단을 총동원해서 즉각 시민들이 투표하실 수 있도록 하라. 투표용지가 없어서 투표를 못 하는 시민이 단 한 분이라도 있어선 안 된다”고 했다.)

Oh's campaign also appealed to citizens, saying, "We know this is very inconvenient and frustrating, but we earnestly ask you to please vote. Do not worry and please wait, ensuring you exercise your vote." (오 후보 캠프는 시민들을 향해서도 “많이 불편하시고 불쾌하시겠지만 간곡히 부탁드린다. 꼭 투표해 달라”면서 “절대 염려하지 마시고 꼭 기다려주셔서 반드시 한 표를 행사해 달라”고 했다.)

People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok also said, "Seoul citizens, please do not give up on voting," urging, "We strongly demand that voting rights be guaranteed so that citizens who wait can vote even after 6 PM." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표도 “서울시민 여러분, 절대 투표를 포기하시면 안 된다”면서 18시가 넘어서라도 기다리신 시민들께서 반드시 투표를 하실 수 있도록 투표권을 보장할 것을 강력히 촉구한다”고 했다.)

Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jeong Won-oh's campaign also said, "To citizens who have not yet voted or are waiting at polling stations, please vote despite the inconvenience," adding, "Citizens who arrive and wait at polling stations before the closing time can vote until the end. Do not worry and make sure to cast your precious vote." (정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보 캠프도 “아직 투표하지 못하셨거나 현장에서 기다리고 계신 시민 여러분께서는 불편하시더라도 꼭 투표해 달라”면서 “투표 마감 전 투표소에 도착해 대기한 시민은 끝까지 투표할 수 있다. 염려하지 마시고 여러분의 소중한 한 표를 반드시 행사해 달라”고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House Says Ballot Shortage Is "Problem for Election Commission to Address" (靑, 투표용지 부족 사태에 “선관위가 대응할 문제”)
item.description:
Blue House Says Ballot Shortage Is "Problem for Election Commission to Address" (靑, 투표용지 부족 사태에 “선관위가 대응할 문제”)

Regarding the shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations during the local elections on the 3rd, the Blue House stated that it is "a problem for the Election Commission to address." The stance is that since the Election Commission is an independent constitutional body, not part of the executive branch, it is not a matter for the Blue House to resolve. (청와대는 지방선거가 치러진 3일 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 데 대해 “선관위가 대응해야 할 문제”라는 입장을 냈다. 선관위는 행정부 소속이 아닌 독립된 헌법기관이므로, 청와대가 나서서 해결할 문제가 아니라는 취지다.)

Earlier that afternoon, voters had to wait at some polling stations in Seoul due to a shortage of ballot papers. Some voters reportedly gave up on voting, and at certain polling stations, only those who had received waiting numbers were allowed to vote until 10 p.m., further fueling controversy. National Election Commission Secretary General Heo Cheol-hoon issued a "public apology" at 9 p.m., stating, "We have caused great confusion and concern to the people." (앞서 이날 오후 서울 지역 일부 투표소에서 투표 용지가 부족해 유권자들이 대기하는 상황이 발생했다. 일부 유권자가 투표를 포기한 것으로 알려졌고, 일부 투표소는 대기표를 발급받은 유권자에 한해 오후 10시까지 투표 시간을 연장하면서 논란이 확산했다. 허철훈 중앙선관위 사무총장은 오후 9시 “국민 여러분께 큰 혼란과 심려를 끼쳐 드렸다”며 ‘대국민 사과문’을 발표했다.)

Opposition parties, including the People Power Party and the Reform Party, argued that the ballot shortage inevitably affected the election results and demanded a "halt to vote counting." Calls for a re-vote have also emerged. The Democratic Party of Korea expressed regret toward the Election Commission but maintained its stance that "there will be no re-vote." (국민의힘과 개혁신당 등 야당에선 투표용지 부족 사태가 선거 결과에 영향을 줄 수밖에 없는 상황이라며 “개표 중단”을 요구했다. 재투표 요구도 나왔다. 더불어민주당은 선관위에 유감을 표하면서도 ‘재투표는 없다’는 입장이다.)

item.title: ‘Shortage of Ballot Papers Crisis’: Berlin, Germany Held a Re-election in 2021 (‘투표용지 부족 사태’... 2021년 獨 베를린은 재선거)
item.description:
‘Shortage of Ballot Papers Crisis’: Berlin, Germany Held a Re-election in 2021 (‘투표용지 부족 사태’... 2021년 獨 베를린은 재선거)

In Germany, serious problems were discovered in the elections held in the capital Berlin on September 26, 2021. Through lawsuits, the elections were invalidated, and a re-election took place two years later. This led to a change in mayor and caused fluctuations in each party’s seats in the national parliament. The election commissioner for the state of Berlin, equivalent to the head of a South Korean provincial or metropolitan election commission, resigned. (독일에서는 2021년 9월 26일 수도 베를린에서 치러진 선거에서 심각한 문제가 발견돼, 소송을 통해 선거가 무효화되고 2년 뒤 재선거가 치러지는 일이 벌어졌다. 이로 인해 시장이 바뀌었고, 각 당의 국회 의석 수에도 변동이 생겼다. 한국의 시·도선관위원장에 해당하는 베를린주 선거 책임자는 사퇴했다.)

At that time in Berlin, the federal election, local elections, and a referendum were all held simultaneously. Voters who came to polling stations had to mark six items on five ballot papers for the election of members of the Bundestag (equivalent to South Korea’s National Assembly members), the election of city council and district council members, and the referendum. (당시 베를린에서는 총선과 지방선거 투표, 주민 투표가 한꺼번에 진행됐다. 투표소에 온 유권자들은 한국의 국회의원에 해당하는 연방하원의원을 뽑는 선거와 시의원·구의원 선거, 주민 투표를 위해 5가지 투표용지의 6가지 항목에 기표해야 했다.)

However, due to the poor preparation by the Berlin state election commission, many voters were unable to vote or received invalid ballot papers to cast their votes. First, because the election commission miscalculated the time each voter needed to vote and set up far too few polling booths, voters had to wait in long lines outside polling stations for hours. Ballot papers that should have been sent to other electoral districts were misdelivered, leading voters to mark ballot papers featuring candidates irrelevant to their own district. (그런데 베를린주 선관위의 준비 부실로, 수많은 유권자가 투표를 못 하거나, 효력이 없는 투표용지를 받아 투표하는 일이 벌어졌다. 먼저 선관위가 유권자 한 사람이 투표를 하는 데 걸리는 시간을 잘못 예측하고 기표소를 턱없이 적게 준비한 탓에, 유권자들이 투표소 밖에 줄을 서서 몇 시간씩 기다려야 했다. 다른 선거구로 갔어야 할 투표용지가 잘못 전달돼, 유권자들이 자기 선거구와 무관한 후보자가 적힌 투표용지에 기표를 하기도 했다.)

There was also a shortage of ballot papers, similar to what occurred in the Seoul city election. The election commission prepared fewer ballot papers than the number of voters, resulting in numerous polling stations running out of ballots. These stations temporarily suspended operations and later resumed, accepting votes even after the legal closing time of 6 p.m. Some voters cast their ballots while exit poll results were being reported. Polling station staff sometimes photocopied ballot papers arbitrarily to distribute them, but votes marked on such papers were declared invalid. (이번 서울시 선거에서 벌어진 것과 같은 투표용지 부족 사태도 있었다. 선관위가 유권자 수보다 투표용지를 적게 준비했고, 이 때문에 투표용지가 부족해진 투표소가 속출했다. 이런 투표소들은 운영을 일시 중단했다가 나중에 재개해, 법정 투표 종료 시각인 오후 6시 넘어서까지 투표를 받았다. 일부 유권자는 출구 조사 결과가 보도된 상황에서 투표했다. 투표소 측에서 투표용지를 임의로 복사기로 복사해 배부하기도 했는데, 이 투표용지에 기표한 유권자들의 표는 무효가 됐다.)

Opposition parties challenged the election results, and the Berlin State Constitutional Court ruled that the entire city and district council elections were invalid. The Berlin State Constitutional Court noted, “It was not just a few, but thousands of voters who were unable to vote, were unable to vote validly, voted under unfair conditions, or could not vote without external influence,” and pointed out that this violated the principles of free, universal, and equal elections stipulated in the Berlin state constitution. (야당들이 선거 결과에 이의를 제기했고, 베를린주 헌법재판소는 시의원·구의원 선거 전체가 무효라고 판단했다. 베를린주 헌재는 “단 몇 명이 아니라 수천 명의 유권자가 투표를 하지 못했거나, 유효하게 투표하지 못했거나, 부당한 조건에서 투표했거나, 외부 영향 없이 투표할 수 없었다”고 지적하면서 “베를린주 헌법에 명시된 선거의 자유, 보편성, 평등의 원칙을 침해했다”고 지적했다.)

The Berlin State Constitutional Court specifically addressed the suspension of polling station operations due to a shortage of ballot papers, stating, “Voters waiting to vote were in a situation where they did not know when the polling station would reopen.” It also noted, “It is impossible to determine how many voters, judging that voting was impossible due to long queues and (polling station) suspensions, went home.” The Court estimated that among the approximately 1.84 million votes cast, 20,000 to 30,000 votes had issues, while pointing out, “In some electoral districts, even a difference of just over 100 votes would have been enough to change the allocation of seats.” (베를린주 헌재는 특히 투표용지 부족으로 투표소 운영이 중단된 것에 대해 “투표를 기다리던 유권자들은 투표소가 언제 다시 문을 열지 알 수 없는 상황이었다”고 했다. 또 “긴 대기 줄과 (투표소 운영) 중단으로 투표가 불가능할 것으로 판단하고 집으로 돌아가버린 유권자가 몇 명인지 파악하는 것은 불가능하다”고 지적했다. 베를린주 헌재는 한편 투표함에 투입된 184만여 표 가운데 2만~3만표에 문제가 있었다고 추정하면서도 “일부 선거구에서는 100여 표만 다르게 집계됐더라도 의석 배분을 바꾸기에 충분했을 것”이라고 지적했다.)

The Federal Constitutional Court also invalidated the federal election results in 455 of Berlin’s 2,256 electoral districts and ordered a re-election. The Federal Constitutional Court specifically pointed out that the temporary suspension of operations at some polling stations violated the “principle of public elections.” The principle of public elections means that all electoral processes must be transparent enough for the general public to understand easily, and any suspicions about the election process must be reviewable. However, the Federal Constitutional Court held that an election could only be invalidated if the defects were serious enough to change the outcome. For this reason, the Federal Constitutional Court ordered a re-election only for those electoral districts where defects were specifically confirmed, not for all of Berlin’s electoral districts. (연방헌법재판소도 베를린 2256개 선거구 가운데 455개 선거구의 총선 결과를 무효화하고 재선거를 하도록 했다. 연방헌재는 특히 일부 투표소의 운영이 일시 중단된 것이 ‘공개 선거의 원칙’에 어긋난다고 지적했다. 공개 선거의 원칙이란, 선거의 모든 과정이 일반인이 쉽게 이해할 수 있도록 투명해야 하고, 선거 과정에 의혹이 제기되는 경우 이를 심사할 수 있어야 한다는 원칙이다. 다만 연방헌재는 선거의 결함이 결과를 바꿀 정도여야만 선거가 무효가 될 수 있다고 봤다. 이 때문에 연방헌재는 베를린의 전체 선거구가 아니라 결함이 구체적으로 확인된 일부 선거구에 대해서만 재선거를 실시하라고 결정했다.)

In accordance with the decisions of the two constitutional courts, the re-election for city council and district council seats was held first on February 12, 2023. Berlin voters overwhelmingly supported the opposition Christian Democratic Union, which had lost in the 2021 election, and as a result, the majority party in the city council changed, leading to a change in mayor. This is because the mayor of Berlin is elected by the city council, not directly by voters. On February 11 of the following year, a re-election for the Bundestag took place in some electoral districts in Berlin, changing the number of seats in the Bundestag for four parties. (두 헌재의 결정에 따라 2023년 2월 12일 먼저 시의원·구의원 재선거가 치러졌다. 베를린 유권자들은 2021년 선거에서는 패했던 야당 기독교민주당에 표를 몰아줬고, 그 결과 시의회 다수당이 바뀌면서 시장까지 바뀌었다. 베를린 시장은 유권자들이 직선하지 않고 시의회에서 선출하기 때문이다. 이듬해 2월 11일에는 베를린 일부 선거구에서 총선이 다시 치러져, 4개 당의 연방하원 의석 수가 바뀌었다.)

item.title: Standoff over Ballot Box in Jamsil 7-dong... Election Commission Calls Emergency Meeting at Midnight (잠실7동 투표함 놓고 대치중... 선관위 0시 긴급위원회 소집)
item.description:
The National Election Commission has decided to hold an emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures regarding the shortage of local election ballots in some areas of Seoul on the 3rd. (중앙선거관리위원회가 3일 서울 일부 지역에서 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 것과 관련해 대응책 논의를 위한 긴급 회의를 열기로 했다.)

Heo Cheol-hoon, Secretary-General of the National Election Commission, stated during a meeting with Jang Dong-hyuk, a representative of the People Power Party who visited the election commission office in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province to protest, “We plan to convene an emergency committee at 12:00 AM (midnight on the 4th).” (중앙선관위 허철훈 사무총장은 이날 밤 경기 과천에 있는 중앙선관위 청사를 항의 방문한 국민의힘 장동혁 대표와의 면담 자리에서 “12시(4일 0시)에 긴급 위원회를 소집하려고 한다”고 말했다.)

According to the election commission, as of 6:20 PM on that day, voters were forced to wait at a total of 14 polling stations in Seoul alone—including 12 stations in the Jamsil area of Songpa-gu and others in Gangnam-gu (1 station) and Gwangjin-gu (1 station)—due to ballot shortages. (선관위에 따르면 이날 오후 6시20분 기준 서울 송파구 잠실 일대를 비롯한 투표소 12곳과 강남구 투표소 1곳, 광진구 투표소 1곳 등 서울에서만 총 14곳의 투표소에서 투표용지 부족으로 유권자들이 대기하는 일이 벌어졌다.)

In particular, at the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, set up at the senior center of Woosung Apartment in Songpa-gu, Seoul, a ballot shortage occurred. When election commission staff attempted to remove the ballot boxes after 6 PM, residents gathered to protest, leading to a standoff with police. (특히 서울 송파구 우성아파트 경로당에 마련된 잠실7동 제2투표소에선 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생했는데도 오후 6시 이후 선관위 직원들이 투표함을 반출하려고 하자 이에 항의하는 주민들이 몰려들면서 경찰과 대치하는 상황이 벌어졌다.)

In response, Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon held a press conference at the election commission office that afternoon, bowing his head and saying, “I deeply feel responsible and offer my sincere apologies.” (이와 관련 허철훈 총장은 이날 오후 선관위 청사에서 기자회견을 열어 “책임을 통감하며 깊이 사과드린다”며 고개를 숙였다.)

item.title: Cheon Ho-seong, Advocating for ‘Equal Education,’ Virtually Secures Election as Jeollabuk-do Education Superintendent (‘평등 교육’ 내세운 천호성 전북교육감 당선 확실)
item.description:
In the June 3 election for the Jeollabuk-do Superintendent of Education, candidate Cheon Ho-seong (59) recorded a vote share of 56.5% as of 11:40 p.m., leading candidate Lee Nam-ho (67) who received 43.5%, making his victory virtually certain. (6·3 전북도교육감 선거에서는 천호성(59) 후보가 3일 오후 11시 40분 현재 56.5% 득표율을 기록하며, 43.5%를 얻은 이남호(67) 후보를 앞서며 당선이 확실시된다.)

As the vote tally surpassed the halfway mark and the gap between the two candidates gradually widened, the fierce two-way race between progressive contenders for the top education post in Jeollabuk-do appears to be solidifying into a win for Cheon Ho-seong. (개표율이 중반을 넘어서며 두 후보 간 격차가 서서히 벌어지기 시작한 가운데, 진보 성향 후보 간의 치열한 양자 대결로 이목을 모았던 전북 교육 수장 자리는 천호성 후보의 승리로 굳어지는 모양새다.)

This election is analyzed to have been decisively shaped by differing educational philosophies over the issue of abolishing or retaining autonomous private high schools, as well as a morality debate that persisted until the final stages of the campaign, swaying voters' choices. (이번 선거는 자율형 사립고(자사고) 존폐 문제를 둘러싼 교육 철학의 시각차와 선거 막판까지 이어진 도덕성 공방이 유권자들의 표심을 가른 결정적 분수령이 된 것으로 분석됐다.)

Cheon Ho-seong, a former teacher, prioritized “eliminating inequality” and “equal education” in elementary and secondary school settings as core values during his campaign. His key pledge is to “convert autonomous private high schools into general high schools.” He believes it is necessary to break the cycle that encourages educational hierarchy and deepens inequality of opportunity. (교사 출신인 천호성 후보는 선거 운동 기간 초·중등 교육 현장의 ‘불평등 해소’와 ‘평등 교육’을 최우선 가치로 내걸었다. 그의 핵심 공약은 ‘자사고의 일반고 전환’이다. 교육 서열화를 부추기고 기회의 불평등을 심화시키는 고리를 끊어내야 한다는 게 그의 생각이다.)

A local education industry insider commented, “Candidate Cheon’s argument to provide equal educational environments for all students appears to have drawn support from local parents who were concerned about disparities in their children’s education.” (지역 교육계 관계자는 “모든 학생에게 균등한 교육 환경을 제공하겠다는 천 후보의 주장은 자녀 교육 격차를 우려하던 지역 학부모층의 지지를 이끌어낸 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

In response, candidate Lee Nam-ho countered with a pledge to create “10 Sangsan High Schools,” aiming to foster top-tier high schools. His plan was to prevent the outflow of talented students from the region by developing prestigious schools and to elevate the overall quality of Jeollabuk-do education by sharing infrastructure with general high schools. However, it is interpreted that Jeollabuk-do voters showed greater support for Cheon, who advocated for equal education and strengthening public interest. (반면 이남호 후보는 최고 수준의 고등학교를 육성하는 이른바 ‘상산고 10개 만들기’ 공약으로 맞불을 놓았다. 명문 학교를 육성해 지역 내 우수 인재의 유출을 막고, 인프라를 일반고와 공유해 전북 교육 전반을 상향 평준화하겠다는 구상이었다. 하지만 전북 유권자들은 평등 교육과 공공성 강화를 주장한 천 후보에게 더 많은 지지를 보낸 것으로 풀이된다.)

Close to the main election, morality vetting and negative campaigning between both camps also contributed to a tight race until the end. When an official from Lee’s campaign suffered a blow to his credibility after police raided his office over suspicions of media bribery, Cheon’s side intensified pressure by demanding the candidate’s resignation. (본선거에 임박해 양측 캠프가 벌인 도덕성 검증과 네거티브 공방도 막판까지 혼전을 거듭하게 한 요인이었다. 이 후보 캠프 관계자가 언론 매수 의혹으로 경찰의 압수수색을 받으며 도덕성에 타격을 입자, 천 후보 측은 후보 사퇴를 압박하며 공세를 높였다.)

On the other hand, Cheon also faced a counterattack amid allegations of selling posts, stemming from controversy over a recorded phone call about a “promise of a policy director position” that emerged during the unification process. Both candidates flatly denied any political deals or misconduct, engaging in a war of truth. However, it is analyzed that voters ultimately made a strategic choice, weighing the substantive direction of education policy over the allegations themselves. <<>> (반면 천 후보 역시 단일화 과정에서 불거진 ‘정책국장 자리 약속’ 통화 녹음 논란으로 매관매직 의혹이라는 역공을 맞았다. 두 후보 모두 정치적 거래나 비위 의혹을 전면 부인하며 진실 공방을 벌였으나, 결과적으로 유권자들은 의혹 자체보다는 교육 정책의 실질적인 지향점에 무게를 두고 전략적 선택을 내린 것으로 분석된다.)

item.title: Min Hyeong-bae of Democratic Party Likely Elected First Mayor of South Jeolla-Gwangju Metropolitan City: "Region-Led Overwhelming Growth" (초대 전남광주시장에 민주당 민형배 당선 유력… “지역 주도 압도적 성장”)
item.description:
Min Hyeong-bae of Democratic Party Likely Elected First Mayor of South Jeolla-Gwangju Metropolitan City: "Region-Led Overwhelming Growth" (초대 전남광주시장에 민주당 민형배 당선 유력… “지역 주도 압도적 성장”)

In the election for the Mayor of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City held on the 3rd, Min Hyeong-bae (65), candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, took the lead, outpacing candidates from the People Power Party, Progressive Party, Justice Party, and an independent. <<> With his victory becoming likely around 10 PM that day, Candidate Min stated, “An opportunity has arrived for South Jeolla and Gwangju to unite and leap forward as a new growth axis for the Republic of Korea,” adding, “The path of overwhelming growth led by the region is one that South Jeolla and Gwangju will prove first.” <<> He continued, “I will repay you with an integrated special city where each citizen’s life improves, a great communal world where everyone prospers together.” As of 10 PM that day, Candidate Min’s vote share stood at 81.37%. <<> Gwangju and South Jeolla are set to launch as an integrated special city in July. This marks 40 years since Gwangju was separated from South Jeolla in 1986. Candidate Min has been elected as the first mayor of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Special City in this election. <<> As of 10 PM that day, the vote shares for the South Jeolla-Gwangju mayoral candidates were: Lee Jeong-hyeon (68) of the People Power Party at 9.29%, Lee Jong-wook (59) of the Progressive Party at 3.65%, Kang Eun-mi (56) of the Justice Party at 4.04%, and independent Kim Gwang-man (65) at 1.62%. <<> Born in Haenam, South Jeolla, Candidate Min served as the mayor of Gwangsan District after being consecutively elected in 2010 and 2014, and later served as a National Assembly member (Gwangju Gwangsan District) during the 21st and 22nd terms. <<> Candidate Min’s first pledge as Mayor of South Jeolla-Gwangju Special City is to “establish a citizen-sovereign government.” This involves transforming the integrated special city’s policies into a structure where citizens propose, deliberate, implement, and evaluate them. He also pledged to “attract a global semiconductor factory within one year of being elected.” <<> In this election, South Jeolla recorded the highest voter turnout nationwide at 65.7%. The national average turnout was 61%. Gwangju Metropolitan City’s voter turnout was only 54.3%, ranking it the lowest in the country again, following the 2022 local elections. (3일 치러진 전남광주통합특별시장 선거에서 더불어민주당 민형배(65) 후보가 국민의힘, 진보당, 정의당, 무소속 후보들을 따돌리며 선두를 차지했다.)

item.title: 24 Years After His Father... Projected Victory for Son as Taean County Mayor (아버지 이어 24년 만에... 아들이 충남 태안군수 당선 확실)
item.description:
In the Taean County mayoral election in South Chungcheong Province, People Power Party candidate Yoon Hee-shin (58) secured 59.66% of the vote as of 00:00 on the 3rd (ballot count rate 75.82%), leading Democratic Party of Korea candidate Kang Cheol-min (69) who received 40.33%, with the victory appearing certain. If Yoon is elected, it will mark the first father-son county mayor in Taean since the start of local elections in 1995. Yoon’s father, former Taean County Mayor Yoon Hyung-sang, was elected twice as a member of the United Liberal Democrats in the 1st and 2nd local elections and served two terms as county mayor. After his father’s term ended in 2002, the son is set to take the county mayor’s position 24 years later. (충남 태안군수 선거에서는 국민의힘 윤희신(58) 후보가 3일 오전 0시 현재(개표율 75.82%) 59.66%를 득표해 40.33%를 얻은 더불어민주당 강철민(69) 후보를 앞서 당선이 확실시된다. 윤 후보가 당선되면 1995년 지방선거가 시작된 이후 태안에서 첫 부자(父子) 군수가 탄생하는 것이다. 윤 후보의 부친인 윤형상 전 태안군수는 지난 1·2회 지방선거에서 자유민주연합 소속으로 당선돼 두 차례 군수를 지냈다. 2002년 부친의 군수 임기가 끝난 후 24년 만에 아들이 군수 자리에 오르게 됐다.)

Yoon stated, “I acutely felt the residents’ desire to change Taean amid difficult realities such as population decline, regional economic stagnation, and youth exodus,” adding, “I will implement ‘management-oriented administration’ for the welfare of all residents and create a Taean that unites through harmony and integration, not conflict and division.” (윤 후보는 “인구 감소와 지역 경제 침체, 청년 유출 등 어려운 현실 속 태안을 바꿔야 한다는 군민들의 바람을 절실히 느꼈다”면서 “군민 전체의 복리를 위한 ‘경영 행정’을 실행하고, 갈등과 분열이 아닌 화합과 통합으로 하나 되는 태안을 만들겠다”고 말했다.)

Yoon served as an aide to National Assembly member Seong Il-jong and was elected to the South Chungcheong Provincial Council after running in the 2022 local elections. In this election, with Democratic Party of Korea incumbent Taean County Mayor Ka Se-ro, who was seeking a third term, eliminated in the primary, the race unfolded as a contest between candidates without an “incumbent premium.” (윤 후보는 성일종 국회의원 보좌관을 지내고, 2022년 지방선거에 출마해 충남도의원에 당선됐다. 이번 선거에선 3선을 노리던 더불어민주당 소속 가세로 태안군수가 경선에서 탈락한 가운데 ‘현직 프리미엄’ 없는 후보 간 대결로 펼쳐졌다.)

During his campaign, Yoon emphasized his strong execution capability, saying, “I learned from my father that politics is not about power but about responsibility.” (윤 후보는 선거 운동에서 “(부친에게) 정치는 권력이 아니고 책임이라는 것을 배웠다”면서 실행력 강한 후보임을 강조했다.)

As part of his pledges, he proposed forming a “Sales Planning Group” to provide one-stop administrative services from attracting corporate investment to obtaining permits, and prioritizing the construction of a section of a highway connecting to Anseong in Taean, which currently lacks a highway. He also vowed to attract a National Defense Future Aviation Research Center to draw defense companies to Taean. (그는 공약으로 ‘세일즈 기획단’을 구성해 기업의 투자 유치부터 인허가까지 이뤄지는 원스톱 행정을 펼치고, 고속도로 없는 태안에 안성까지 연결하는 고속도로 일부 구간을 우선 건설하겠다고 했다. 국방미래항공연구센터도 유치해 방산 기업들이 태안으로 몰려오도록 하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Yoon said, “I will shift the collapsing industrial structure toward future industries and focus all capabilities on attracting businesses and creating quality jobs,” adding, “I will realize an administration that serves the residents, not one that rules over them, and finds answers on the ground.” (윤 후보는 “무너지는 산업구조를 미래산업 중심으로 전환하고, 기업 유치와 양질의 일자리 창출에 모든 역량을 집중하겠다”면서 “군민 위에 군림하는 행정이 아니라 군민을 섬기는 행정, 현장에서 답을 찾는 행정을 실현하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Won-taek of the Democratic Party Confirmed to Win Jeonbuk Governor Election… Proving Strength of 'Number 1' in the Party's Stronghold (민주당 이원택, 전북지사 당선 확실…민주당 텃밭서 ‘1번’ 힘 증명)
item.description:
In the June 3 Jeonbuk Province Governor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek (56) recorded a vote share of 51.5% as of 00:40 on the 4th, leading independent candidate Kim Kwan-young (57), who received 41.8%, with his victory all but certain. Although incumbent Governor Kim Kwan-young was abruptly expelled from the Democratic Party ahead of the election and ran as an independent, Candidate Lee is expected to secure victory by leveraging organizational strength and the local sentiment of the Democratic Party's stronghold. <<> The process of this Jeonbuk governor election was tumultuous. This was because incumbent Governor Kim Kwan-young, who had been preparing for a re-election bid, was abruptly expelled from the Democratic Party on April 1, completely overturning the entire race. <<> The catalyst was an incident captured on a security camera (CCTV) on November 30 last year at a restaurant in Jeonju, where cash was seen changing hands during a meal involving over 20 people, including young party members. Kim explained that "he handed over 680,000 won as payment for a designated driver and recovered the full amount the next day," but the Democratic Party leadership deemed the act of an incumbent regional head providing money as inexcusable and expelled him. <<> After the expulsion, the primary was reorganized into a two-way race between lawmakers Lee Won-taek and Ahn Ho-young, with Lee Won-taek ultimately selected as the Democratic Party's final nominee. However, the election landscape shifted again when Kim officially declared his independent candidacy on the 7th of last month, creating a "Democratic Party versus independent incumbent" dynamic. <<> During the campaign period, various opinion polls showed a tight race between independent candidate Kim Kwan-young and Lee Won-taek, indicating fierce competition. Internal strife also emerged, with former Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil publicly criticizing the party leadership, stating that "the decision to expel Kim has angered Jeonbuk residents." <<> Nevertheless, Candidate Lee appealed for support, arguing that "expelling a candidate with clear ethical issues was a justified measure, and the residents of Jeonbuk will ultimately agree with that judgment." As the election entered its later stages, analysis suggests that the appeal that "for regional development, a Democratic Party governor capable of stably drawing budgets is needed" won over voters' hearts. A local political source commented, "In the end, residents chose the sturdy umbrella and political stability of the Democratic Party over the breakthrough capability of an independent incumbent." <<> Coming from a civic group background, Candidate Lee has served as a Jeonju city councilor, a Blue House administrator, the political affairs deputy governor of Jeonbuk Province, and a 21st and 22nd-term National Assembly member. He is considered close to Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, part of the 'pro-Jung faction'. <<> During the election, he championed 'endogenous development' as his core slogan. He emphasized a region-led, self-sustaining growth model, including the establishment of a pension city utilizing renewable energy like solar and wind power, and fostering 100 Jeonbuk-style star companies. A significant shift is expected from the previous paradigm of provincial administration focused on attracting external businesses. <<> Upon the announcement that his victory was "confirmed," Candidate Lee stated, "Today's victory is not the personal victory of Lee Won-taek, but a great victory for the residents who believed in the future of Jeonbuk and trusted the Democratic Party and President Lee Jae-myung." He added, "Now, Jeonbuk must open the door to a great leap forward through AI, renewable energy, agricultural and life sciences bio, K-Food, and K-Culture," and pledged, "I will create 'real growth, tangible growth' where the fruits of growth return to the lives of the residents and the region." (6·3 전북도지사 선거에서는 더불어민주당 이원택(56) 후보가 4일 오전 0시 40분 현재 51.5% 득표율을 기록하며, 41.8%를 얻은 무소속 김관영(57) 후보를 앞서며 당선이 확실시된다. 선거를 앞두고 김관영 현역 지사가 민주당에서 전격 제명돼 무소속으로 출마했지만, 이 후보는 조직력과 민주당 텃밭이라는 지역 정서를 등에 업고 승리를 거머쥘 것으로 보인다.)
